worked.problem: In ΔABC, draw altitude CD to AB. Derive a/sin A = b/sin B using a = BC and b = AC.
actions: Draw CD perpendicular to AB; label CD = h, BC = a and AC = b.
In right triangle ACD, sin A = h/b, so h = b sin A.
In right triangle BCD, sin B = h/a, so h = a sin B.
Equate the two heights: b sin A = a sin B; divide by sin A sin B.
Answer: a/sin A = b/sin B. Check both ratios equal ab/h for nondegenerate triangles.
worked.check: Answer: a/sin A = b/sin B. Check both ratios equal ab/h for nondegenerate triangles.

worked.problem: In ΔABC, A = 40°, B = 70° and a = 8 cm. Find b to two decimal places.
actions: Label a = BC = 8 cm opposite A = 40°, and b = AC opposite B = 70°.
Draw an altitude to see the sine rule a/sin A = b/sin B.
Substitute: 8/sin(40°) = b/sin(70°).
Rearrange: b = 8 sin(70°)/sin(40°) = 11.70 cm.
Answer: b = 11.70 cm. Check: b sin(40°) and 8 sin(70°) agree before rounding.
worked.check: Answer: b = 11.70 cm. Check: b sin(40°) and 8 sin(70°) agree before rounding.
